caption:
🌡️🚽 Fever but no cold? Think of a urine infection.

👶 Babies: fever may be the only sign · poor feeding, vomiting · very cranky
🧒 Older kids: burning, passing urine often · tummy or back pain · new wetting at night

🧪 The test needs a clean urine sample, NOT from the nappy. Your doctor will show you how.

💚 Help your child heal:
1️⃣ Finish the full antibiotic course
2️⃣ Plenty of fluids
3️⃣ Don't hold urine: toilet every 3–4 hours
4️⃣ Wipe girls front to back
5️⃣ Treat constipation too

🚨 See a doctor URGENTLY if:
• Baby under 3 months with fever
• Vomiting, can't keep medicine down
• Very sleepy or very unwell
• Fever not better after 2 days of antibiotics
• Urine infections that keep coming back
